title: "Brownian Motion"
jupyter: python3

The stochastic differential equation is

$$
dX_t = \sqrt{2D}\,dW_t.
$$

In two dimensions,

$$
\mathbb E\left[|X_t-X_0|^2\right]=4Dt.
$$

::: {#20670c53 .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import numpy as np

D = 1.0
dt = 0.01
N = 1000

increments = np.sqrt(2 * D * dt) * np.random.randn(N)
trajectory = np.cumsum(increments)

trajectory[:10]
```
